d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Algeria vs Dominican Republic in Group J of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Algeria claimed a 1-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha thanks to a first-half goal from Yacine Abed. Algeria finish second in Group J to reach the round of 32, while Dominican Republic finish third on four points, enough to advance as one of the best third-placed teams.
